newsitem.title: GERMANY: Kohl to meet Chernomyrdin in Moscow on Saturday.
newsitem.headline: Kohl to meet Chernomyrdin in Moscow on Saturday.

text.p: German Chancellor Helmut Kohl will stop over in Moscow on his way back from an Asian tour on Satuday to hold talks with Russian Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin, his chancellery said.
They will meet at a Moscow airport for the talks during a technical stopover there, a spokesman said.
The chancellor, one of Boris Yeltsin's staunchest western supporters, would not see the ailing Russian president during his stay.
Yeltsin is due to undergo heart bypass surgery, possibly as early as next week.
Kohl's Asian tour has taken him this week to Indonesia and the Philippines. He plans to visit Japan from Thursday to Saturday before returning via Moscow to Bonn.
